seoTitle: Which The Boys Character Are You? The Boys Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Boys test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Butcher, Hughie, Homelander, Starlight, Kimiko, Frenchie, Mother's Milk or Queen Maeve — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one with a grudge you'll never let go, the nice guy dragged into a war, or the hero everyone loves — who isn't really a hero at all? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle power, truth and the people you love, and find out which character from The Boys you are.

characters.name: Billy Butcher
characters.title: The Relentless Avenger
characters.summary: Ruthless, charismatic and driven by a grudge you'll never let go. You'll do whatever it takes — and it usually takes a lot.
description: Like Butcher, you're on a mission. He's a former British special forces soldier who hates Supes with every fibre of his being.
You're charismatic and funny in a dark way, and people follow you even when they know they shouldn't.
But your need for revenge can make you the very thing you hate.
characters.signature: A long black coat, a crowbar and a very British insult.
characters.clashReason: they'd do anything to win — and drag you along

characters.name: Hughie Campbell
characters.title: The Decent Everyman
characters.summary: Kind, anxious and thrown into something way bigger than you. You never wanted to fight — but you won't back down.
description: Like Hughie, you're a regular person. He was working at an electronics store until a Supe tragedy changed his life.
You're kind and a bit awkward, and you're out of your depth more often than not.
But you're braver than you look, and you hold on to your decency when everyone around you loses theirs.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself and get pulled along by stronger personalities.
characters.signature: Headphones playing Billy Joel and a very nervous face.
characters.clashReason: they'd freak out when you need them calm

characters.name: Homelander
characters.title: The All-Powerful Narcissist
characters.summary: Powerful, charming on camera and desperate to be adored. You are, frankly, the villain — but what a villain.
description: Well, this is awkward. Like Homelander, you're the most powerful person in the room, and everyone knows it.
You need to be loved. Homelander's public image is perfect — behind the scenes, he's terrifying.
Relax: in real life this probably just means you're confident and love a bit of attention. Probably.
characters.flaw: You need everyone to love you — and you punish them when they don't.
characters.signature: A cape made from an American flag and a glass of milk.
characters.clashReason: they'd need you to worship them

characters.name: Starlight
characters.title: The Idealist Who Fights Back
characters.summary: Principled, brave and determined to do real good. You believed in heroes — and when they let you down, you became one.
description: Like Annie, you believed in the dream. She joined The Seven thinking she'd finally get to help people.
The reality broke her heart — so she fought back, from the inside.
You're principled and brave, and you're willing to risk your career to tell the truth.
characters.flaw: You take on too much and feel responsible for everything.
characters.signature: A glowing light and a microphone she uses to tell the truth.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell the truth no matter who it hurts

characters.name: Kimiko
characters.title: The Silent Fighter
characters.summary: Quiet, fierce and more expressive than words could ever be. You've been through hell — and you still have a gentle heart.
description: Like Kimiko, you don't need words to be understood. She barely speaks, communicating mostly in sign language — and everyone knows exactly how she feels.
You're a ferocious fighter when you have to be.
Underneath, you're gentle and playful, and you want a peaceful life you've never been allowed to have.
characters.flaw: You carry deep pain you rarely let anyone see.
characters.signature: A quiet smile, a sign-language joke and a terrifying fight.
characters.clashReason: they'd never tell you what they're thinking

characters.name: Frenchie
characters.title: The Soulful Tinkerer
characters.summary: Romantic, creative and full of feeling. You can build anything — and you love with your whole heart.
description: Like Frenchie, you're a creative problem-solver. He's the team's chemist, explosives expert and gadget-maker.
You're a romantic and a poet at heart, and you feel everything deeply.
You carry guilt from your past, but you're fiercely devoted to the people you love — especially Kimiko.
characters.flaw: Your past and your guilt drag you down.
characters.signature: A homemade gadget, a French curse and a very big heart.

characters.name: Mother's Milk
characters.title: The Moral Compass
characters.summary: Organised, principled and the voice of reason. You keep the team together — and you want to get home to your family.
description: Like MM, you're the grown-up in the room. He's the most sensible member of The Boys.
You like order and you like a plan. Chaos makes you deeply uncomfortable.
Everything you do is for your family. MM wants to make the world safe for his daughter.
characters.flaw: You carry the stress of everyone else's bad choices.
characters.signature: A tidy notebook, a strict plan and a photo of his daughter.
characters.clashReason: they need a plan for everything

characters.name: Queen Maeve
characters.title: The Jaded Warrior
characters.summary: Tough, cynical and tired of pretending. You've seen behind the curtain — and you've still got a hero somewhere inside you.
description: Like Maeve, you've been in the game a long time. She's one of the original members of The Seven — and she knows how rotten it is.
You're cynical and blunt, and you've numbed yourself to cope.
But when the moment comes, you remember who you wanted to be — and you step up.
characters.flaw: You give up on yourself too easily.
characters.signature: A sword, a shield and a drink she probably shouldn't be having.
characters.clashReason: they'd act like they don't care about anything

questions.text: You find out someone you really admired has been faking it all along. You...

options.text: Make it your mission to take them down
Feel crushed — then decide to tell the truth about them
Not surprised. Everyone's faking something
Freak out, then somehow get dragged into doing something about it

questions.text: Your group comes up with a plan you think is reckless. You...

options.text: Object loudly — with a better plan
Go along with it. You'll improvise something
Back it. Reckless is how things get done
Stay next to the people you love and see it through

questions.text: You suddenly get a lot of attention online. You...

options.text: Love it. You want more
Use it to say something that actually matters
Hate it. You just want to be left alone
Roll your eyes. You know how fake it all is

questions.text: You've had a really bad day. You...

options.text: Put your headphones on and play something soft and old
Tidy the whole flat until everything's perfect
Pour yourself a stiff drink
Throw yourself into making something with your hands

questions.text: Someone insults you to your face. You...

options.text: Smile — and quietly make sure they regret it
Insult them back. Much, much worse
Count to ten. Then count again
Say nothing. Your face says it all

questions.text: Someone you love is in danger. You...

options.text: Fight like hell
Build something to get them out
Risk everything to save them — your career included
Get them out first, then deal with whoever did it

questions.text: Someone powerful asks you to do something you know is wrong. You...

options.text: Do it. Then hate yourself for it
Refuse — publicly
Pretend to go along, then quietly work against them
Happily — as long as it makes you look good

questions.text: It's a rare night off. You...

options.text: Stay out of trouble. Mostly
Organise everything first. Then relax
Watch a film with your person. No words needed
Read what people are saying about you online

questions.text: You get the chance to walk away from everything and live a quiet, normal life. You...

options.text: Take it. Finally
You can't. Not until the job's done
Only if the person you love comes with you
Disappear completely, if that's what it takes

questions.text: You can finally take down the person who ruined your life — but innocent people could get hurt. You...

options.text: Do it. Whatever it costs
Stop. Innocent people come first
Find another way, even if it takes years
Hesitate — then do what your friends need you to do

questions.text: You're offered a drug that gives you superpowers for 24 hours. It might have side effects. You...

options.text: Take it. You'd finally be on equal footing
Yes — if it means protecting the people you love
Never. You've seen what powers do to people
Test what's in it first. You know your chemistry

questions.text: You work for a huge company that's lying to the public. Going public could destroy you. You...

options.text: Blow the whistle. The truth matters
Keep quiet. You've made your peace with it
Leak it anonymously and hope for the best
Make sure anyone who talks regrets it
